as_told.title: Nimitz Tic Tac case that Spielberg cites

plain: In 2004, off San Diego, Navy pilots from the aircraft carrier Nimitz, among them a fighter pilot named David Fravor, reported a "Tic Tac", a white oval object shaped like the mint. Michels brings it up twice in his own words, calling it one of the "holy grail events" of the subject, the case on which many people rest their belief that UFOs are real. In one telling he adds that the film director Steven Spielberg cites the case as what renewed his own interest in UFOs.
